answers.rationale: The requirement describes a mechanism for disconnecting transformer fuses and grounding them, which is a feature of metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is suitable as it is arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear designed to IEEE C37.20.2 standards, which aligns with the described functionality.

The requirement specifies insulation and contact material for primary contacts, which are standard features of metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product meets these specifications as it adheres to IEEE C37.20.2 standards for metal-clad switchgear.

The requirement specifies VT compliance with ANSI C57.13, which is a standard for instrument transformers. The CROWN-ARMV product includes provisions for VTs and complies with relevant ANSI standards, making it suitable.

The requirement describes CT specifications and testing, which are integral to metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product supports CTs and adheres to ANSI C37.20.2 and C57.13 standards, fulfilling the requirement.
The requirement specifies KWH meter sockets, which are typically included in metal-clad switchgear for metering purposes. The CROWN-ARMV product can be configured to include such features.
The requirement specifies a test switch assembly, which is a standard accessory for metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product can include such assemblies as part of its configuration.

The requirement specifies interlock contacts and auxiliary relays, which are standard components in metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product supports these features as part of its control scheme.

The requirement specifies control power circuit fuses and a control scheme, which are standard in metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes these features, adhering to ANSI C37.11 standards.
The requirement specifies cell switches and spare contacts, which are standard in metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product supports these features as part of its design.

The requirement specifies detailed wiring and control design, which are integral to metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes factory-installed internal control wiring and adheres to the specified standards.
